headline: Daily research brief — Friday, October 2

items.title: Binary-event premium dominates the watchlist's front end
items.detail: AAPL, MSFT, TSLA and NVDA term structures hump exactly over their earnings dates — implied event moves of ~4.5%, ~6.7%, ~8.0% and ~7.2% respectively. Those IV-over-realized gaps are event pricing, not mispricings; premium into any of the four event windows stays off-limits. The only un-conflicted premium is at the index level: SPY 30-day IV 12.45% vs 20-day realized 10.07%, a modest +2.4 point cushion nearly clean of single-day contamination.

items.title: Energy is a mild-but-persistent margin headwind with a diesel tail
items.detail: WTI pulled back ~3% on the G-7's 100M-barrel emergency release plan (diesel front-loaded over 20 days), but the physical market disagrees — Dated Brent above $120 against ICE Brent near $101. Distillates sit 14% below the five-year seasonal average and China reinstated its refined-product export ban for October. OPEC+ meets Sunday (expected hold); both are the near-term swing factors.

items.title: 24-year-high rates are the valuation headwind
items.detail: The 10-year retreated to ~5.2% after September's soft jobs report (29K nonfarm vs ~84–90K expected; unemployment 4.1% to 4.2%), cutting October Fed-hike odds from ~70% to ~21%. Discount-rate pressure persists on high-multiple names — AAPL, MSFT, NVDA — even as the pause repricing is mildly supportive. Richer carry mechanically fattens call premium, which favors the premium-selling side.

items.title: One implementable lab find; calendars quiet otherwise
items.detail: purgedcv — a test-pinned, sklearn-native purged walk-forward CV implementation — scored 80: integrate, pending license confirmation. It closes the methodology gap flagged in the 9/25 sweep. Earnings and dividend calendars are clean in-window; QQQ's ~7.6% distribution cut is already ex and reflected in option pricing. IV rank remains unverified for all names.

desks.Earnings: Quiet window — no watchlist reports Oct 2–16. The action is the Oct 21–29 cluster: TSLA 10/21 confirmed, MSFT ~10/27–28 and AAPL ~10/29 estimated but unconfirmed. TSLA's Q3 deliveries beat (486,532 vs ~461K consensus) is already in price.

desks.Parity: Nothing material. Parity-implied VIX-futures forwards (Oct 17.89 / Nov 18.49) sit within 0.16 of quoted feeds — parity holding. The lab's 'Year-End Toll' 2–3 bp Dec-31 rate wedge is logged as a rate-extraction caution, not a violation.
desks.Premium: IV exceeds realized on all six, but the AAPL/MSFT/TSLA/NVDA gaps are binary-event pricing, not mispricings. Un-conflicted only at the index level: SPY 30-day IV 12.45% vs 20-day realized 10.07% (+2.4 pts, just under the window-contingency line). IV rank unverified for all.
